summary_1line: Bhishma explains duties and social status of offspring from different varna unions, detailing mixed castes and their prescribed occupations.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, instructs Yudhishthira about the origins and duties of mixed castes as sages listen nearby.
A Chandala stands at the outskirts of a city with executioner’s tools while townspeople keep their distance.
